system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for verifying the abstract consensus specification. It reformulates the inductive invariant of the consensus specification so that it can serve as an initial predicate for TLC, enabling TLC to check that the invariant is preserved by every step of the specification.
actors_and_components: Same as the base consensus specification: no explicit processes, just the set of proposable values and the chosen set. This module extends the base consensus specification.
state_variables: Same as the base consensus specification: the set of chosen values. The type invariant is restated so that the chosen set is declared as an element of the power set of the value set (required for TLC to use it as an initial predicate).
initial_state: The initial state for inductive invariant checking is the invariant itself (not the original empty-set initial state). This allows TLC to explore all states satisfying the invariant and verify that every successor state also satisfies it.
actions: Same as the base consensus specification: the single transition that selects a value when no value has yet been chosen.
safety_properties: The inductive invariant asserts that the chosen set is a subset of the value set and has cardinality at most one. This module provides a specification whose initial states are all states satisfying the invariant, enabling TLC to verify inductiveness.
model_bounds: The set of proposable values is instantiated with a finite set. For model checking, the value set is typically small (for example, three model values).
additional_assumptions: This module is a companion to the base consensus specification and relies on the definitions and operators from that specification. It is used specifically for model-checking the inductive invariant with TLC.
